The Second Book of Modern Verse

I went out to the woods to-day / To hide away from you, / From you a thousand miles away— / But you came, too.

—
Paradox

Jessie B.

Rittenhouse

 

The Second Book of Modern Verse

A Selection from the Work of Contemporaneous American Poets

Edited by Jessie B. Rittenhouse

This sequel to 
The Little Book of Modern Verse
 constitutes 195 works by 92 authors and forms a “small, intimate volume” representative of the working poets of the day.
